notes: Surface water carries algae and organic load that a screen alone cannot hold.
Moderate hazard: automatic backflush recommended; schedule chemical treatment.

schedule.target: carbonate scale, iron and manganese oxide precipitation
schedule.indicative_dose: lower line pH to 5.5-6.5 during treatment
schedule.frequency: monthly, or when discharge drop exceeds 5 percent

schedule.indicative_dose: flush velocity >= 0.30 m/s (0.50 m/s for silty water)
schedule.frequency: monthly minimum; weekly for surface water

items.Item: Dripline 16 mm, Inline PC 4.0 L/h at 0.50 m (+3 % waste)
Mainline / submain pipe 110 mm PVC PN6
Air / vacuum release valve (one per manifold, one per 400 m of mainline)
Trenching and backfill for buried pipe (manifolds, submains, mainline)
